scenes.title: De Volta ao Quarto Oito (Home to Room Eight)
scenes.summary: After settling the retired mapmaker happily at table one under the shade tree, F1, M2, and M3 step to the front desk to fetch the green guest book and brass key number 8.

scenes.title: Fatias de Bolo de Verão (Slices of Summer Cake)
scenes.summary: At the bustling café counter, F2 plates generous slices of berry-and-almond cake while M4 and F1 report that the honoured guest called it identical to thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: O Dueto a Quatro Mãos (The Four-Hand Duet)
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, F3 and M3 perform their joyful four-hand piano duet through the open shutters to warm applause from all twenty-eight courtyard seats.

scenes.title: O Presente do Mapa Ilustrado (The Illustrated Map Gift)
scenes.summary: Under the shade tree, F1 reads the retired mapmaker's warm written toast aloud while M2 and F2 unveil his gift: a framed watercolour map of Rua das Acacias with Cashew Tree Guesthouse glowing at its centre.

scenes.title: Uma Nova Lata Para o Amanhã (A New Tin for Tomorrow)
scenes.summary: As early evening settles in, M1 surprises F1 inside Room 9 with a brand-new brass-rimmed tin box and waxed linen to seal a new time capsule for thirty summers ahead.

scenes.title: Quatro Pequenas Lembranças (Four Small Keepsakes)
scenes.summary: Around the Room 9 table, F2, F3, and M4 place the complete laminated berry-cake recipe, the signed waltz sheet, wooden clothespin number 9, and a fresh group sketch into the new tin.

scenes.title: De Volta Para Baixo da Terceira Pedra (Back Under the Third Stone)
scenes.summary: Under twenty-four glowing lanterns at twilight, M1, M2, and F1 lower the new waxed-cloth capsule into the brick pocket beneath the third flagstone north of the shade tree.

scenes.title: O Envelope do Festival de Outono (The Autumn Festival Envelope)
scenes.summary: Hanging the framed watercolour map beside the front desk at nine in the evening, F1 and M2 discover an official municipal envelope from M4 inviting Cashew Tree Guesthouse into the autumn Historic Courtyard Festival.
